prompt:
You are given a CSV of 20 para-substituted benzene analogues with SMILES, R-group labels, and pIC50 values. Perform R-group decomposition using RDKit's rdRGroupDecomposition with the core SMARTS '[*:1]c1ccccc1'. Identify which R-group (the R1 SMILES string as returned by RDKit) corresponds to the analogue with the highest pIC50. Store this R1 SMILES string in a variable called `best_r1`.

The input CSV is at _TASK_INPUT['file_path']. Columns: SMILES, Name, R_group, pIC50.
